welcome_text: Welcome to Our School Welcome to Montessori at the Courtyard – Bedford, TX! At Montessori at the Courtyard, we are committed to providing an authentic Montessori education that honors each child's individuality and supports their natural development. In our thoughtfully prepared classrooms, children are empowered to make independent choices, cultivate self-discipline, and progress at their own unique pace. Our environment is intentionally designed to inspire curiosity, hands-on learning, and discovery across a wide range of subjects. We serve children from six weeks to six years of age. Our mixed-age classrooms foster a collaborative community where younger children learn through observation and interaction with older peers, while older children develop leadership, mentoring, and social responsibility. Central to the Montessori philosophy is social and emotional development: children are guided to resolve conflicts constructively, understand the perspectives of others, and respect personal boundaries. Families are supported through Montessori Compass, an online platform that provides insight into your child's daily experiences and facilitates meaningful communication with their teachers. We warmly invite you to schedule a tour to experience firsthand the transformative, child-centered learning that unfolds every day at Montessori at the Courtyard. We look forward to welcoming your family into our Montessori community.

Meet Our Staff Marianette Sustache Morales, Director Certifications : Texas Director's License, CPR, First Aid Hola! I'm Marianette. My journey with LCG began in 2021 at Colleyville Montessori, where I started as an Administrative Assistant and later served as Assistant Director. I then joined Children's Courtyard as a Director, but my passion for Montessori education brought me back to this community. I am thrilled to be part of this school and look forward to helping families find the right Montessori environment for their children. In my free time, I enjoy spending quality moments with my family. Visit Us Today We can't wait to show you all the wonderful things happening at our school!
